```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r read_3_tables}
con = DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "../data/midwest_airbnb_extended.db")
listings     = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "listings") |> tibble::as_tibble()
availability = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "availability_monthly") |> tibble::as_tibble()
reviews      = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "reviews_monthly") |> tibble::as_tibble()
DBI::dbDisconnect(con)
```

## Task 1

```{r task1}
host_counts <- listings |>
  dplyr::count(host_id, name = "host_listing_count")
listings_with_counts <- listings |>
  dplyr::left_join(host_counts, by = "host_id")

A1 <- listings_with_counts |>
  dplyr::filter(host_listing_count >= 10) |>
  dplyr::distinct(host_id) |>
  dplyr::summarize(hosts_10_plus = dplyr::n())

A2 <- listings_with_counts |>
  dplyr::filter(city == "Chicago") |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    percent_held_by_10_plus =
      mean(host_listing_count >= 10) * 100
  )

A1
A2
```

## Task 2

```{r task2}
family_price <- listings |>
  dplyr::filter(
    room_type == "Entire home/apt",
    accommodates >= 4,
    number_of_reviews >= 10,
    review_scores_rating >= 4.8
  ) |>
  dplyr:: mutate(price_per_person = price / accommodates) |>
  dplyr::group_by(city, neighbourhood) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    median_family_price = median(price_per_person),
    n = dplyr::n()
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(n >= 20)

family_price |>
  dplyr::filter(city == "Columbus") |>
  dplyr::arrange(median_family_price)
```

## Task 3

```{r task3}
median_revenue <- listings |>
  dplyr::group_by(city, room_type) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    dplyr::across(
      c(price, reviews_per_month, estimated_revenue_l365d),
      ~median(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  )

median_revenue |>
  dplyr::filter(
    city == "Twin Cities",
    room_type == "Entire home/apt"
  )
```

## Task 4

```{r task4}
top_concentration <- listings |>
  dplyr::group_by(city) |>
  dplyr::arrange(
    dplyr::desc(estimated_revenue_l365d),
    .by_group = TRUE
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    top_10 = dplyr::row_number() <= ceiling(0.10 * dplyr::n())
  ) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()

top_concentration |>
  dplyr::filter(city == "Columbus") |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    top_10_percent =
      sum(estimated_revenue_l365d[top_10], na.rm = TRUE) /
      sum(estimated_revenue_l365d, na.rm = TRUE) * 100
  )
```

## Task 5

```{r task5}
october_availability <- availability |>
  dplyr::filter(month == "2026-10")

entire_homes <- listings |>
  dplyr::filter(room_type == "Entire home/apt")

year_ahead <- entire_homes |>
  dplyr::left_join(october_availability, by = "id") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    mostly_taken = nights_available < 0.5 * nights_in_month
  )

year_ahead |>
  dplyr::group_by(city) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    mostly_taken_share = mean(mostly_taken, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(mostly_taken_share)
```

## Task 6

```{r task6}
demand_by_season <- reviews |>
  dplyr::filter(
    month >= "2025-07", month <= "2026-06"
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(listings |>
    dplyr::select(id, city),
    by = "id"
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(city, month) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    total_reviews = sum(reviews, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

twin_cities_demand <- demand_by_season |>
  dplyr::filter(city == "Twin Cities") |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(total_reviews))

twin_cities_demand

twin_cities_demand |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    quiet_month_ratio =
      max(total_reviews) / min(total_reviews)
  )
```

## Task 7

```{r task7}
superhost_summary <- listings |>
  dplyr::filter(
    room_type == "Entire home/apt",
    !is.na(host_is_superhost)
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    host_type = dplyr::if_else(
      host_is_superhost == "t", "Superhost", "Other"
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(city, host_type) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    median_price = median(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_rating = median(review_scores_rating, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

superhost_summary

superhost_premium <- superhost_summary |>
  dplyr::select(city, host_type, median_price) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = host_type,
    values_from = median_price
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    premium = Superhost - Other
  )

superhost_premium
```

## Task 8

```{r task8}
lost_listings <- listings |>
  dplyr::anti_join(
    availability,
    by = "id"
  )

lost_listings |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    missing_availability = dplyr::n()
  )

lost_listings |>
  dplyr::count(city) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n))
```
## B2

```{r b2}
Task_1 <- listings_with_counts |>
  dplyr::filter(
    city %in% c("Chicago", "Columbus", "Twin Cities")
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(city) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    percent_held_by_10_plus =
      mean(host_listing_count >= 10) * 100
  )

Task_2 <- listings |>
  dplyr::group_by(city) |>
  dplyr::arrange(
    dplyr::desc(estimated_revenue_l365d),
    .by_group = TRUE
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    top_10 = dplyr::row_number() <= ceiling(0.10 * dplyr::n())
  ) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    share_top_10_revenue =
      sum(estimated_revenue_l365d[top_10], na.rm = TRUE) /
      sum(estimated_revenue_l365d, na.rm = TRUE) * 100
  )

B2 <- Task_1 |>
  dplyr::left_join(Task_2, by = "city")

B2
```
